scenario_recommendation.interpretation: Retain the user's $10–200bn range for exploration. Use $10–50bn as an illustrative working range and label $100–200bn as a transformational stress scenario. Five years has direct precedent in two primary announcements; two years is an accelerated deployment stress case. Announcements do not establish a global actual total or probabilities.
required_distinctions: Total funding is not supplier procurement.
Only new cash deployed within scope should feed annual spending; prior datasets and in-kind resources must be separated.
Show compute, construction, people, software/services, clinical development and wet-lab tools as distinct capture assumptions.

Funding-to-capacity conversion requires a productive baseline, stage-specific capital intensity, utilization, installation lag and efficiency assumptions. Announcements alone cannot prove a 2–10x capacity multiple.
A 2x minimum is a user-defined growth scenario constraint, not an evidence-supported guaranteed outcome. Include an explicitly identified no- or low-growth/efficiency case if practical.
Stage 0 cell data, multiomics and imaging have direct program relevance; commercial bioprocess purification is farther downstream and should not receive the same immediate elasticity by default.
